skillFull: A starry night sky appears at certain intervals. Points are granted at increments while the night sky is visible. The Cookie's Energy drain rate also slows down during this time. Level Up for more points from Starry Night Skies and an even slower Energy drain.
story: Born amongst the stars, Dreamcatcher roams the night sky, collecting warm and shimmering starlight. After a fateful encounter, Dreamcatcher learned the power of sharing dreams from Moonlight Cookie. Legends say that no matter how exhausted or discouraged you are, receiving a dream from this Pet will guarantee a blissful slumber.

costumes.name: Night Sky Suncatcher
costumes.info: The Dreamcatcher has gathered light since the first light of dawn. All to shine endlessly like a sun on the Cookies to give them happiness. Even cloudy and rainy days shine bright like stars in the night sky!
